implementation_summary: auditEditsRoutes({store}) returns GET (access view) and PATCH (access edit) rows for /api/audits/:id/edits. ?version= picks a version (latest default). PATCH: 404 unknown audit/version, 409 running, body via readJsonBody (2,000,000 char cap), validateAuditEditsPatch, 400 for finding id/page/Section not in the version or the start page being removed, mergeEditsPatch, saved as edits.json beside the result through the store (result never written), edited flag set, replies {edits}. Store failures map to fixed sentences.
tests_proposed: Dispatch-level test through RunnerServer once BE-190 registers the rows (helper edit grant vs view-only grant)
Concurrent PATCH test against a Cloud Storage backend stub
risks: Per-version save queue is in-process only; multiple runner instances could still overwrite each other.
Section edits are validated against stored Page Content (pages/<slug>-<hash>); a version without it refuses all Section edits with 400.
edited flag is set after the overlay write; a failure in between leaves the overlay saved and the flag unset.
The tsc check was a grep filtered on audit-documents; a tsc failure could have been missed.
handoff: BE-190: register ...auditEditsRoutes({ store }) with store = createAuditStore(selectAuditStoreBackend({ dataDir })). Rows set method, path and access from AUDIT_API and no beta policy. packages/runner/src/routes/index.ts does not yet export audit-documents.ts; other route tasks adding rows to the file must merge them. Edit access for Helpers depends on RunnerServerOptions.helperGrants.
